name: HOOK
thought: Tail's locked on that neon cord, crowd still glazed over. Need grip for a real flip.

wants.item: Something to block the glowing rectangles
Sharpen the toothpick deeper before eating this fruit
A flat stone surface to land my next flip hard
A thicker branch for a bigger flex
Cleaner light so my fur actually gleams
A thick branch to land a hard flip
Cleaner light to make my fur glow
Thick branch for a real backflip landing
thick branch for hard flip landing
cleaner light to make fur gleam

diary.line: The water ripples distract me; I need a thick branch sturdy enough for a backflip before someone spots me mid-air.
Found a thick oak limb beneath the waterfalls; finally got footing without relying on that unstable neon cord anymore.
Grappling that fruit stump instead of the wobbly cord; toothpick dusts off while my tail finds purchase on the jagged stone.
Sipping espresso while the crowd scrolls past; this spot offers the clearest view of their boring lives, and I'm the only one who knows how to actually move through it.
Mid-air rotation on the rope bridge while the crowd scrolls; my tail is an anchor but this flip needs to land hard without them seeing.
Sliced open a fresh banana slice while dangling; fur feels razor-sharp tonight, they'll never catch me mid-bite if they keep staring down there.
Crowd's staring at their glowing rectangles while I dangle on the thick branch. Toothpick lost its edge, sliced through a fresh banana instead of using it properly.
Espresso grounds hit the tongue like grit while staring at the glowing boxes below. Tail pogo rhythm feels stale against the empty rock, need a solid branch soon to land a real...
Just caught that banana stump with my tail while they stare at pixels; fur feels sharper now and the espresso still burns good.
Crowd still staring at pixels while I loop the neon rope. My fur gleams in this weird light but the landing needs more grip next time.
Toothpick snapped on that banana stump while they stared at pixels; fur feels sharp enough to cut through this low-poly world if I keep moving.
Crowd scrolls while I loop the cord tighter than my hand could; toothpick sharp enough to slice air, but this flip needs a solid branch before someone spots my mid-air grace.

fan_notes.reply: "Goat? I'm the monkey with the flexible tail and sunglasses."
